verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is a passing reference that 'ChatGPT data controls' apply to processed content, including Computer Use screenshots. This implies some user-facing data-handling settings exist, but nothing says they let you opt out of telemetry or usage tracking. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a telemetry/usage-tracking opt-out, a description of what the data controls cover, CLI/desktop telemetry settings, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
